The atmosphere in this camp is a mixture of anxiety and suspicion. Its denizens eye you warily, what words they share with you are few and vague, as if they fear divulging too much. 

This land is not a hospitable one. Ruled by Darth Malak and his Sith Empire, Korriban is among his worlds. Sith spies are everywhere, and their patrols, both of patrols and of Sith Initiates eager to spill blood to prove their worth, are watchful of trespassers. 

You will need to be on guard here, and to be ready for anything.
